items.evidence: Scratch repo with this worktree's .githooks, held sidecar committed on main, origin/main at the pre-acquire commit: `git update-ref refs/heads/main <pre>`, `git branch -f main <pre>`, `update-ref --stdin` (update without old), `reset --hard <pre>`, `update-ref HEAD <pre>` with HEAD->main, and a symref alias -> main all exit 128 with 'reference-transaction refused' and main stays at the acquire commit; same with origin/main deleted. Negative control: the same probe with .githooks+src from c5750a967^ admits update-ref/branch -f/--stdin (main rewound, sidecar gone). Creating an absent main with hooks wired succeeds (rc 0). Injected rev-parse failures with status 128, 129, 2 and undefined, and an empty stdout with status 0, all return 'failing closed'. Hook runs only in the prepared phase, so rev-parse refs/heads/main reads the pre-update value.

`export { g as default } from` refuses with 'exported as default', also multi-line, with a comment inside the specifier, via `./../scripts/read.mjs`, `export { g, g as default } from` behind a forwarding barrel, and `export { default as g } from` over a default barrel; `import { default as h }` from a named barrel stays stale (refuses). HEAD tests: declarations 66/0. The same test file run against the f4324b27d scanner fails 6 (4 default re-export subtests + parent + configured-adapter default case). Full-tree `--root .`: 0 undeclared, class counts byte-identical to the c5750a967 scanner (configured-binary 95, declared-tooling-exemption 19, rust-test 139, hook-read-context 26, ...).

ES2022 string export names bypass the W45-2 fix: barrel `export { g as "default" } from './read.mjs';` + caller `import h from './barrel.mjs'; h(['reset','--hard']);` scans with 0 sites and no escape, so the declared-tooling-exemption on read.mjs still passes. Same for `export { g as 'x-y' } from` + `import { 'x-y' as h } from`. Node 24.18 runs both (prints g:reset). Pre-existing at f4324b27d; not used anywhere in the repo today. The follower compares the raw alias token (`"default"` !== 'default') and pushes the quoted token as a name that no caller can match.
items.fix: In the named re-export loop, strip matching quotes from `alias` (and `original`) before comparing; treat an unquoted value of `default` as the existing 'exported as default' escape and any alias that was quoted and is not a plain identifier as an escape ('exported under a string name'). Add both spellings to the re-export matrix in test/scripts/git-one-door-declarations.test.mjs.
